[1/2] Fix the two reported reforge findings and prepare delivery

impact_assessment.why: The reforge run reported two low findings that had no safe automatic patch: a leftover empty HTML block in README and silent skipping of malformed calibration rows.
impact_assessment.benefits: Removes dead markup and makes a bad calibration CSV visible instead of silently shortening the LUT.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: README markup and calibration logging only; first-row header handling must stay silent
impact_assessment.mitigation: Treat only the first row as the header, warn for later malformed rows, rerun the project test and gate suite, and inspect the staged diff before pushing.

[1/2] Add the launcher UI contract and sync the canonical AL-1.1 text

impact_assessment.why: The project has a desktop UI, but the auto-generated contract used requirements.txt as its surface and was removed; the license text also drifted from the canonical AL-1.1 copy.
impact_assessment.benefits: The UI guard now targets the real launcher surface, the check warning about a missing contract disappears, and the license matches licenses/AL-1.1.md.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: .aikit/ui.json surface app -> launcher.py; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: UI contract and license text only
impact_assessment.mitigation: Run the fast unittest proof and all four project gates, compare LICENSE with licenses/AL-1.1.md, and inspect the staged diff before committing.

[1/2] Enable strict UI evidence and finish a reviewed launcher UI task

impact_assessment.why: The UI contract now targets launcher.py, but strict delivery evidence is still off, so a UI change could ship without a finished, reviewed UI task.
impact_assessment.benefits: Delivery will require a UI task whose surface digest matches launcher.py, closing the last warning and making UI drift visible.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: ui_required becomes true; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: .aikit/project.json, .aikit/ui_task.json and .aikit/ui_history.json
impact_assessment.mitigation: Begin from a clean baseline, run the fast unittest proof, record a real human review of the launcher, then rerun check --strict before pushing.
